The disposition of these trees was picturesque and beautiful in the extreme. Here, at the end of a sweeping vista, and in the midst of an open space covered with the greenest sward, stood a mighty broad-armed oak, beneath whose ample boughs, though as yet almost destitute of foliage, while the sod beneath them could scarcely boast a head of fern, couched a herd of deer.

arxiv-2004-06367.title: Enumerating Chemical Graphs with Mono-block 2-Augmented Tree Structure from Given Upper and Lower Bounds on Path Frequencies
arxiv-2004-06367.creator: Yuui Tamura, Yuhei Nishiyama, Chenxi Wang, Yanming Sun, Aleksandar Shurbevski, Hiroshi Nagamochi, Tatsuya Akutsu
arxiv-2004-06367.description: Abstract Abstract. We consider a problem of enumerating chemical graphs from given constraints concerning their structures, which has an important application to a novel method for the inverse QSAR/QSPR recently proposed. In this paper, the structure of a chemical graph is specified by a feature vector each of whose entries represents the frequency of a prescribed path.

arxiv-2010-06328.title: Assessing the Helpfulness of Review Content for Explaining Recommendations Conference: SIGIR 2019 Workshop on ExplainAble Recommendation and Search; July 25, 2019; Paris, France CCS: Information systems Recommender systems CCS: Human-centered computing User studies
arxiv-2010-06328.creator: Diana C. Hernandez-Bocanegra, Jürgen Ziegler
arxiv-2010-06328.description: Abstract . Despite the maturity already achieved by recommender systems algorithms, little is known about how to obtain and provide users with a proper rationale for a recommendation. Transparency and effectiveness of recommender systems may be increased when explanations are provided. In particular, identifying of helpful argumentative content from reviews can be leveraged to generate textual explanations.

arxiv-2011-00781.title: Searching k-Optimal Goals for an Orienteering Problem on a Specialized Graph with Budget Constraints
arxiv-2011-00781.creator: Abhinav Sharma, Advait Deshpande, Yanming Wang, Xinyi Xu, Prashan Madumal, Anbin Hou
arxiv-2011-00781.description: Abstract We propose a novel non-randomized anytime orienteering algorithm for finding k-optimal goals that maximize reward on a specialized graph with budget constraints. This specialized graph represents a real-world scenario which is analogous to an orienteering problem of finding k-most optimal goal states.

arxiv-2102-00076.creator: L. Hunold, S. Lagomarsino, A.M. Flatae, H. Kambalathmana, F. Sledz, S. Sciortino, N. Gelli, L. Giuntini, M. Agio

Here, we present the scalable production of silicon-vacancy (SiV) color centers in single-crystal diamond by ion implantation.

arxiv-2105-08981.creator: Peter Wölfle, Timothy Ziman
arxiv-2105-08981.description: Abstract The effect of scattering of conduction electrons by dynamical spin fluctuations on the thermopower in metals near a thermal phase transition into an antiferromagnetic phase is considered. arxiv-2112-10232.title: Direct and approximately valid probabilistic inference on a class of statistical functionals
arxiv-2112-10232.creator: Leonardo Cellaand, Ryan Martin
arxiv-2112-10232.description: Abstract Existing frameworks for probabilistic inference assume the quantity of interest is the parameter of a posited statistical model. In machine learning applications, however, often there is no statistical model/parameter; the quantity of interest is a statistical functional, a feature of the underlying distribution.

Lyngby, Denmark † Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management, Norwegian University of Science and Technology, Trondheim, Norway s184386@student.
arxiv-2204-11246.description: Abstract As a common practice, the direction of natural gas flow in every pipeline is determined ex-ante for simplification purposes, and treated as a given parameter within the scheduling problem. However, in integrated gas and electric power networks with a large share of intermittent renewable power supply, it is no longer straightforward to optimally predetermine the gas flow directions.

arxiv-2510-19651.title: Heisenberg-Limited Quantum Eigenvalue Estimation for Non-normal Matrices
arxiv-2510-19651.creator: Yukun Zhang, Yusen Wu, Xiao Yuan
arxiv-2510-19651.description: Abstract Estimating the eigenvalues of non-normal matrices is a foundational problem with far-reaching implications, from modeling non-Hermitian quantum systems to analyzing complex fluid dynamics. Yet, this task remains beyond the reach of standard quantum algorithms, which are predominantly tailored for Hermitian matrices. Here we introduce a new class of quantum algorithms that directly address this challenge.

pmc-11526374.title: Customizable Three-Dimensional Printed Zerovalent Iron: An Efficient and Reusable Fenton-like Reagent for Florfenicol Degradation
pmc-11526374.creator: Dan Li, Yibo Fu, Wentao Hong, Shunlu Li, Mulan Qiu, Hongdie Yu, Heli Wang, Junhong Wu, Qian Yang, Sen Yang, Jianhui Xu, Yunfei Zhang, Shenggui Chen, Yin Zhong, Ping’an Peng
pmc-11526374.description: Zerovalent iron (Fe0)-based Fenton-like technology has great potential for treating recalcitrant organic pollutants (ROPs) in wastewater. However, rapidly and precisely manufacturing Fe0-based materials with the desired geometries is challenging. Herein, novel three-dimensional printed Fe0 (3DP-Fe0) and bimetallic 3DP-Ni/Fe0 were customized by 3D printing for efficient Fenton-like degradation of florfenicol (FLO), a typical antibiotic in wastewater.

pmc-12606222.title: A real-world cohort study of immune-related adverse events in patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors
pmc-12606222.creator: Yanfei Wang, Yi Guo, Aik Choon Tan, Lili Zhao, Xu Shi, Yong Chen, Ramon C. Sun, Mei Liu, Jing Su, Thomas J. George, Jiang Bian, Qianqian Song
pmc-12606222.description: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed cancer care but are frequently associated with immune-related adverse events (irAEs), complicating treatment. This retrospective cohort study analyzed 9193 adult patients from the OneFlorida+ Clinical Research Network who received ICIs between 2018 and 2022, aiming to identify risk factors for irAEs and evaluate their incidence, severity, and clinical impact.

uslaw-usc-t8-s1260.title: 8 U.S.C. § 1260 — Removal of aliens falling into distress
uslaw-usc-t8-s1260.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t8-s1260.description: United States Code, Title 8 (Aliens And Nationality); Chapter 12 (Immigration And Nationality); Subchapter II (Immigration); Part V (Adjustment And Change Of Status). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Attorney General may remove from the United States any alien who falls into distress or who needs public aid from causes arising subsequent to his entry, and is desirous of being so removed.
